rationale: Colin brings 20 years of infrastructure and developer ecosystem experience—including hands-on work with AI tooling, multi-agent systems, and GPU cloud infrastructure at Nebius—while Jess is building something in stealth with a full-stack technical foundation (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript). Colin's background bridging cutting-edge infrastructure with builders, combined with his explicit mentoring in developer relations and ecosystem building, could be valuable as Jess scales; conversely, Jess's early-stage founder perspective and technical execution experience offer ground-truth feedback on what developers actually need.
intro_message: Colin Nebius, meet Jess Tada — you're both SF-based builders at different stages, and Colin's 20 years in infrastructure + community-led growth (Dabl.Club, Nebius) could complement Jess's founder journey.
